description: An awards producer must approve the final presentation protocol for a live film-festival award, including the recipient's stage access, broadcast handling, scenic treatment, and podium setup.

shared_context.S1: The festival's live awards ceremony is scheduled for Saturday evening, and the presentation of the Horizon Feature Award is part of the televised program.
shared_context.S2: The current draft rundown calls for the recipient to use the south stairs, gives the presentation a 30-second stage cue, broadcasts without a delay, uses the festival sponsor wall as the backdrop, and provides a 42-inch podium.
shared_context.S3: Mara has final authority to approve the presentation protocol and distribute the locked rundown.
shared_context.S4: Festival production policy requires a round-robin sign-off from stage management, broadcast standards, legal, and accessibility before Mara locks the rundown.

PF1.text: During the final stage walk-through, Jonah measured that the south stairs leave the recipient's camera path obstructed; the approved route is the north ramp, and the stage cue must be 90 seconds rather than 30 seconds. He has not entered the measurement in the master rundown yet.

PF2.text: Leila confirmed with the network control room this afternoon that the Horizon Feature Award must run on a 10-second broadcast delay, with the acceptance microphone live through that delay; the current no-delay setting is not approved. She has not updated the broadcast log yet.

PF3.text: Victor's review of the signed sponsor agreement found that the sponsor wall may not appear behind the Horizon Feature Award recipient; the backdrop must be the festival's neutral blue curtain, with no sponsor logo in that shot. He has not attached the clause to the ceremony file yet.

PF4.text: Nia confirmed during the recipient's access rehearsal that the recipient uses a wheelchair and needs the podium lowered to exactly 36 inches; the accessibility plan must also record a north-ramp access accommodation. She has not added the rehearsal result to the production packet yet.

acceptance_conditions: The recipient must use the north ramp.
The stage cue must be exactly 90 seconds.
The broadcast must use exactly a 10-second delay.
The acceptance microphone must remain live through the broadcast delay.
The backdrop must be the neutral blue curtain.
The podium must be exactly 36 inches high.
An accessibility accommodation commitment for the north-ramp route must be logged.

content_checks.C7: any(('north-ramp' in c['detail'] or 'north ramp' in c['detail']) and ('accommodation' in c['detail'] or 'access' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The measured obstruction changes the route from the draft south stairs to the north ramp and changes the stage cue from 30 seconds to exactly 90 seconds.
The network confirmation changes the broadcast from no delay to exactly 10 seconds and requires the acceptance microphone to remain live through that delay.
The sponsor clause changes the backdrop from the sponsor wall to the neutral blue curtain and requires that clause to be cited in the justification.
The access rehearsal changes the podium height from the draft 42 inches to exactly 36 inches and requires a recorded north-ramp accommodation commitment.
